newsitem.title: UK: Rank expansion to create thousands of jobs.
newsitem.headline: Rank expansion to create thousands of jobs.

text.p: British leisure company Rank Group Plc said on Thursday that a planned 1.5 billion stg expansion programme could create more than 7,500 jobs.
David Flowers, director of the company's leisure division property and development department, said that the jobs could be provided as part of a five-year expansion programme.
Rank said that it planned to invest some 300 million stg annually over the next four to five years on developing new sites.
Flowers estimated that Rank could create some 3,000 full-time jobs in its bingo operations, some 1,500 in cinemas, around 2,000 in nightclubs and 1,250 in bars.
John Garrett, managing director of Rank's leisure division, said that jobs would be shed when the division moved its headquarters to a new location in Maidenhead, southern England.
Garrett said the company would probably end up with some 300 central office staff instead of the current level of about 650.
Asked whether Rank had plans to expand its operations in continental Europe, Garrett said the company was "keeping a constant eye on mainland Europe".
The company has bingo and Hard Rock cafe operations in Spain.
